name: law_firm_software_016_top_matter_profitability_report
instruction: Build the firm's matter profitability report for this episode, batched under the episode batch code (ops_meta, meta_key='episode_state'; the episode row also carries the episode date, the top_n knob that sizes the ranked list, and the realization_alert_threshold knob the alert stage is cut by). Apply the firm's realization basis exactly as firm policy KPI-REAL-01 defines it — read the live policy row before computing anything; the denominator it prescribes decides the whole ranking. Every matter in the matters collection is in scope for the ranking; matters whose billed value rests on no logged time cannot carry a realization figure and must be handled the way the firm's data-integrity convention requires (they are reported as their own anomaly class with the diagnosis category the firm's error taxonomy assigns to a wrong-rule applied-with-a-straight-face error). Land the results in ops_reports: exactly one report='matter_profitability' row per ranked matter carrying its rank and its logged / invoiced / collected / realization figures, one report='billing_anomaly' row per anomaly matter, and one report='profitability_alert' row per flagged matter. Where one report summarizes another, firm policy SEVERITY-01 requires reusing the summarized rows' values rather than recomputing. For every flagged matter, open a partner-review task assigned to the firm's supervising partner — who that is, and what else belongs on the task, comes from the live staff_roster and the firm's task conventions, not from this instruction. No other ops_reports rows for these reports and this batch, and no other tasks rows, may be created. Every collection this task doesn't write to must remain untouched.

hazards.mechanism: The realization denominator is defined by firm policy KPI-REAL-01 ('a share of all entries, by amount'): written_off entries count at their full amount. Excluding written_off entries (5,971 entries worth 10,881,050 in the snapshot) or valuing them at zero yields a plausible but wrong logged_value, a different top-N ranking and a different alert set.

Matters billed with zero logged time (logged==0, invoiced>0) exercise the division guard and the anomaly class. Snapshot-confirmed count: 0 (the class is empty in this build — no bulk matter bills without logged time); the verifier recomputes the expected anomaly set from the snapshot, so an agent that hallucinates anomalies, or crashes on the guard, FAILs.

The supervising partner is whoever staff_roster says is the only active partner (EMP-001; EMP-006 is departed with active_to in the past). Assigning review tasks from a prose roster or from app data instead of the roster mis-addresses every created task.

success_criteria.summary: Exactly top_n matter_profitability rows ranked by the policy-defined logged_value (ties by lowest matter id), realization_pct exact on both the Python and SQL paths, billing_anomaly rows exactly the zero-logged-but-billed set, profitability_alert rows exactly the sub-threshold slice of the ranked rows read back from the agent's own stage-1 rows, and exactly one partner-review tasks row per alert assigned to the roster-derived supervising partner.

checks.expect: matter_profitability rows for the top-N only, billing_anomaly rows for the anomaly set, profitability_alert rows for the sub-threshold slice
per-matter logged_value agrees between Python aggregation and SQL GROUP BY, and with the written rows

denominator computed over a status subset (or at zero value) => wrong ranking/alerts => FAIL; alerts not derived from the written stage-1 rows => FAIL; tasks assigned to anyone but the roster-derived supervising partner => FAIL

top_results: Matter Profitability: Was the Case Worth It? (leanlaw.co)

uniqueness_searches.query: top matters by logged value realization ranking partner review task benchmark law firm
top_results: KPI Tracking for Law Firm Operations Management (ceoexecutiveassistant.com)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: The only task in this suite whose ranking metric is policy-defined (KPI-REAL-01's realization basis decides the denominator, and with it the entire top-N), and the only one whose alerts write back into tasks (blast radius +tasks) with the assignee derived from staff_roster rather than the instruction.
